name: Hob
gmNotes: Hob is a fey role, not a Species; this card is linked to the Hob Archetype. expertRegions remains the campaign's home region (Ireland) as a provisional choice. Images remain empty pending art direction.
deepLore: Hobs or Hobgoblins are rougher than ordinary Brownies and more fond of practical jokes. They are more closely associated with outdoor farm chores.
description: A rougher household spirit, fond of practical jokes, tied to outdoor farm work.
feyKnowledge: Hobs are semi-independent, middle-status rural maintenance contractors. Unlike Brownies, they are independent, sell the goods they receive to labs or other facilities, and have no contract clauses preventing them from receiving gifts. They may nevertheless be personally offended by handouts. Like Brownies, they usually wear brown filter caps. Some occasionally run behavioural experiments on humans for laboratories, which humans may interpret as practical jokes. They are not full-time researchers like Boggarts.
unlockGuidance: Deep Lore: farm folk and storytellers may know hob ways; if feyLoreUnlocksDeepLore is set and the party has Fey Lore, grant Deep Lore at first discovery. Fey Knowledge: reveal through a mission, revelation, or a rural maintenance Fey — asking a Fey may require a Bargain or Grace consequences.
commonKnowledge: Brownies or Hobs are helpful but capricious and elusive household spirits who perform work while the family sleeps.
